knowledge:
- key_parameters: type=The spatial statistic method to run (e.g., "moran", "localG", "lee", "multispati") ;; colGraphName=The name of the spatial neighborhood graph stored in the SFE object (e.g., "visium") ;; swap_rownames=The column name in rowData (e.g., "symbol") to use for identifying features instead of default rownames ;; include_self=Logical indicating whether to include self-loops in the spatial graph, specifically used for Getis-Ord Gi* (localG) ;; features=A character vector of gene names or colData columns to analyze or plot ;; maxcell=The maximum number of pixels to plot from the background image to prevent slow rendering ;; nfposi/nfnega=The number of positive and negative spatial autocorrelation components to compute in MULTISPATI PCA
- alternatives: scater/scran=Used for non-spatial single-cell preprocessing, normalization, and highly variable gene selection ;; spdep=The underlying classic geospatial R package that Voyager wraps for univariate and local spatial statistics ;; adespatial=The package containing the original MULTISPATI PCA implementation, which Voyager implements in a faster but less flexible manner ;; Seurat=Mentioned as a spatial tool that only plots centroids, whereas Voyager plots actual geometries
- when_to_use: Use when you have spatial transcriptomics data (e.g., 10x Visium) and want to perform exploratory spatial data analysis (ESDA) to identify spatial autocorrelation, find hotspots/coldspots, compute spatially-informed gene correlations, or perform spatially-constrained dimension reduction.
- pitfalls: Image alignment=The origin of the tissue image is often at the top-left while the spots are at the bottom-left, requiring mirrorImg() to align them ;; Duplicate gene symbols=A warning is thrown if a gene symbol matches multiple Ensembl IDs when using swap_rownames ;; Bivariate storage=Global bivariate results (like Lee's L) cannot be stored directly inside the SFE object in the current version of Voyager ;; Negative eigenvalues=MULTISPATI PCA can yield negative eigenvalues, which represent negative spatial autocorrelation ;; Self-correlation=Lee's L of a gene with itself is not 1 due to a spatial smoothing factor

workflows.name: spatial_exploratory_data_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform exploratory spatial data analysis (ESDA) on spatial transcriptomics data, including univariate, bivariate, and multivariate spatial statistics, and visualize the results over tissue geometries.
input: sfe (SpatialFeatureExperiment object containing spatial coordinates, count matrix, and geometries)
workflows.stages: 1. Load required libraries and read the SpatialFeatureExperiment dataset ;; 2. Add and mirror the tissue image to align with spatial coordinates ;; 3. Filter spots to keep only those in tissue and normalize counts ;; 4. Construct a spatial neighborhood graph using findVisiumGraph ;; 5. Run univariate spatial statistics (Moran's I and Getis-Ord Gi*) using runUnivariate ;; 6. Identify highly variable genes and calculate bivariate spatial correlation (Lee's L) using calculateBivariate ;; 7. Perform spatially-informed dimension reduction (MULTISPATI PCA) using runMultivariate ;; 8. Visualize gene expression, local spatial statistics, eigenvalues, and reduced dimensions in spatial context using plotting functions
workflows.code:
library(SFEData)
library(SpatialFeatureExperiment)
library(SpatialExperiment)
library(ggplot2)
library(Voyager)
library(scater)
library(scran)
library(pheatmap)

if (!file.exists("tissue_lowres_5a.jpeg")) {
    download.file("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pachterlab/voyager/main/vignettes/tissue_lowres_5a.jpeg",
                  destfile = "tissue_lowres_5a.jpeg")
}

sfe <- McKellarMuscleData()

sfe <- addImg(sfe, imageSource = "tissue_lowres_5a.jpeg", sample_id = "Vis5A", 
              image_id = "lowres", scale_fct = 1024/22208)

sfe <- mirrorImg(sfe, sample_id = "Vis5A", image_id = "lowres")

sfe <- sfe[,colData(sfe)$in_tissue]
sfe <- logNormCounts(sfe)

colGraph(sfe, "visium") <- findVisiumGraph(sfe)

features_use <- c("Myh1", "Myh2")

sfe <- runUnivariate(sfe, type = "moran", features = features_use, 
                     colGraphName = "visium", swap_rownames = "symbol")

rowData(sfe)[rowData(sfe)$symbol %in% features_use,]

sfe <- runUnivariate(sfe, type = "localG", features = features_use,
                     colGraphName = "visium", include_self = TRUE, 
                     swap_rownames = "symbol")

head(localResults(sfe, name = "localG")[[1]])

gs <- modelGeneVar(sfe)
hvgs <- getTopHVGs(gs, fdr.threshold = 0.01)

res <- calculateBivariate(sfe, "lee", hvgs)

pheatmap(res, color = scales::viridis_pal()(256), cellwidth = 1, cellheight = 1,
         show_rownames = FALSE, show_colnames = FALSE)

hvgs2 <- getTopHVGs(gs, n = 1000)
sfe <- runMultivariate(sfe, "multispati", colGraphName = "visium", subset_row = hvgs2,
                       nfposi = 10, nfnega = 10)

plotSpatialFeature(sfe, c("nCounts", "Myh1"), colGeometryName = "spotPoly", 
                   annotGeometryName = "myofiber_simplified", 
                   aes_use = "color", linewidth = 0.5, fill = NA,
                   annot_aes = list(fill = "area"), swap_rownames = "symbol")

plotLocalResult(sfe, "localG", features = features_use, 
                colGeometryName = "spotPoly", divergent = TRUE, 
                diverge_center = 0, swap_rownames = "symbol",
                image_id = "lowres", maxcell = 5e+4)

ElbowPlot(sfe, ndims = 10, nfnega = 10, reduction = "multispati") + theme_bw()

spatialReducedDim(sfe, "multispati", ncomponents = 2, image_id = "lowres", 
                  maxcell = 5e+4, divergent = TRUE, diverge_center = 0)
